failure.message: The broker worker could not enter the task checkout beneath a mode-0700 temporary parent directory. It stopped before the Python observer, compilation or any GPU work.

retry.reason: The frozen plan permits zero retries. This checkout was not normalized and the task was not resubmitted after the environmental failure.

claim: No kernel-correctness or performance claim is supported by this attempt; ADR 0036 remains proposed until a separately frozen future successor produces the missing B200 observation.
